about.title: Hi, I'm Imaad
body: I'm from Peoria, Illinois, and studied Computer Science at the University of British Columbia, graduating in 2025. When I took my first introductory programming course in school, I instantly fell in love with the field. I knew that the combination of intense problem solving and creative freedom characteristic of software engineering was perfect for me. Now I work as a full-stack software engineer at Tesla, building web applications for the Global Financing Engineering team, and I still spend my time learning new technologies and enjoying everything programming has to offer.
When I'm not typing away at a computer I love to play the drums, hyperanalyze TV shows (I could talk for days about Succession), and, if you couldn't tell by the website, learn about space.
I'm always happy to connect, so please feel free to message me if you'd like to chat!

projects.title: Subletter
body: Subletter is a virtual marketplace for university students created to ensure that only fellow students respond to a student's listings. This project allowed me to branch out and truly develop my full-stack ability, especially since it was the first project in which I designed and implemented a database. In this project, I am most proud that I implemented a live messaging interface, designed using Socket.IO. I also fully developed the login system, leveraging tools such as JSON Web Tokens and bcrypt to securely authenticate users.

projects.title: Right Angle
body: Born from the constant discomfort of an intern sitting at a desk for 8 hours a day, Right Angle is a web application that helps users correct their posture. It works by using OpenCV with MediaPipe to calculate whether or not a user is slouching, and if they are, the program alerts them. I worked on the backend of this application, with a special focus on enabling a livestream from OpenCV to the browser.

projects.title: Spam Text Classifier
body: This was my first end-to-end machine learning project, where I trained and tested my own classification model to determine whether or not a text was spam. The project involved developing my own custom transformer to clean and process the data, refining the model with cross validation, and finally testing it on the test data. The model ended up performing with 100% precision, 94% recall, and 97% accuracy; an impressive showing!

projects.title: Spotify Collage
body: Spotify Collage is a web application I developed during a hackathon that gives users a clean and stylish interface with which they can interact with a variety of different playlists. The application makes use of the Spotify Web API and was built entirely in Flask. All styling in the application was done by me in vanilla CSS, long after the hackathon was complete so I could develop my frontend skills.

experience.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
experience.subtitle: Tesla
body: As a full-stack software engineer on Tesla's Global Financing Engineering team, I lead the end-to-end development of internal and customer-facing web applications, including the Payment Estimator now used across 400+ Tesla stores in North America. I optimized a high-traffic bulk order retrieval API, cutting data load times by 83% and meaningfully improving system responsiveness, and led a re-architecture of our access control system, redesigning permission flows and onboarding to a new authorization framework for better security, scalability, and maintainability. I also designed an automated stipulation-notification workflow that lets 16 external banking partners review and decision customer documents directly within Tesla's platform, eliminating manual email-based processing and significantly cutting turnaround time.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
experience.subtitle: Tesla
body: As a software engineer intern on Tesla's Fintech Services team, I used schema-driven development to architect modular React and TypeScript components, and redesigned and refactored over 25 UI components as part of a major design overhaul of internal business tools. I also developed and deployed a new API route integrating with LaunchDarkly to enable controlled rollouts for 12+ feature launches, and built scalable backend APIs in C#/.NET using an MVC approach to support new finance workflows and data pipelines.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
experience.subtitle: Intel
body: As a software engineer intern with Intel's NEX Cloud Networking Group, I developed and validated software for network interface cards, and refactored legacy procedural C#/.NET test suites into an object-oriented design, reducing the occurrence of test conflicts by 95-99%. I also implemented a new manageability feature and added over 500 automated tests to the regression and CI pipelines, enhancing test coverage and reliability.
